kind: offline independent installer cold-read and private negative controls

checks.message: Retained candidate bytes equal native author inventory for all four modules
Authenticated original pair and absent helpers are admitted
Independent private install writes exact four retained candidates
Later contributor edit refuses complete revert before any restore
Corrupt backup refuses complete revert before any restore
Revert restores authenticated pair and removes exact helpers
Occupied new helper refuses a stale installation
Production target refuses install without explicit production mode
Every production path remains byte-identical or absent throughout independent review

limits: Explicit whole-source ownership lease is still required; byte guards are not concurrent locking.
A multi-file interrupted write may leave a partial candidate; journal supports guarded recovery, not an atomic four-file transaction.
This does not accept visual quality, native Main geometry, rendered batch cost, GPU memory, timing, exports or Mac performance.
